title: sail.py draft names every missing chart-spec field in one pass
intention: sail.py draft refuses an incomplete chart spec by naming every missing field in one pass, and drafts nothing.
why: Law 7 (errors are loud at diagnostic surfaces, and named): 2026-11-19, charting 2a530dc20826 and 3413bea597fc: `sail.py draft <id> <spec>` died twice per ticket with a Python traceback, first KeyError: 'why_now', then on the next run KeyError: 'expect'. drafts_of (cairn/devices/cc/scripts/sail.py:89) indexes each piece's fields directly, so a spec missing a field is a crash naming one key per run, never a named lack. It writes nothing (the dict is built before the first t.draft). The partial chain the orchestrator saw in the Dell commons came from the driver going on to `sail.py chart` after draft exited 1, which charted 2a53's stale 2026-11-14 drafts. That was CC's driver, not this helper.
traces_to: Law 7; Law 1 (one pass, not one key per run)
how: In cairn/devices/cc/scripts/sail.py, before drafts_of builds anything, collect every missing key: the spec's own fields (request, intent, scope, constraints, bounds, sought, holdings, absences, pieces, criteria) and each piece's (what, why, why_now, kind, fills, uses, writes_to, expect, falsifier, instrument). Then draft() prints them all on stderr and returns 2 before any t.draft. Take the key lists from the literal in drafts_of itself so there is one list. cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_a_draft_names_every_missing_spec_field.py: one tooth per clause, over a scratch ticket as test_a_redraft_over_a_standing_validate_berth_is_charted_or_refused.py does.

clauses.claim: a spec missing several piece/spec fields makes `sail.py draft` exit non-zero with no traceback, naming every missing field (with its piece) in one pass, and no stage is drafted
a complete spec drafts orient through validate as before

decisions.text: D1: draft() checks the spec's and each piece's fields before drafts_of and names every lack.
D2: red-first proof cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_a_draft_names_every_missing_spec_field.py, one tooth per clause.

out: the chart stages and their doors
